description:
The census tests pin counts, and beside each pinned number a comment records how it moved and which ticket moved it: `// fz-5xp.30: 1430 -> 1447 ...`, `// fz-kdt.106: 805 -> 742, zero-change 13 -> 9 ...`. Counted 2026-09-15 by grepping for a ticket id followed by an arrow: src/telemetry/public_trace_test.rs 83, src/compiler2/work_start_reason_test.rs 4, tests/fz2_cli.rs 3. A change log lives in the commit that made the change; a comment beside a pin says what the count is and what would move it, or nothing, since the assertion message already names the pin. Review rule stated on PR #168 by the maintainer ("how is this kind of comment helpful?") and applied to the ten comments that branch added.

Fix: delete every delta comment; where one contains a present-tense fact worth keeping (what a count is composed of, why two counts must agree), keep that sentence without the ticket id or the arrow. Signal: the grep above returns zero; the pinned values do not change.
title: Census pins carry a change log in comments
